D65 Studio 0.3.1 — optional LOAD compatibility (experimental)

Use it
------
Open Merge D81s, enable Include START launcher, then enable Experimental LOAD
compatibility (ROM 920413). Select the source D81s and save a new compilation.
Use Export to SD card with a new filename, mount it in MEGA65 drive 8, and enter
RUN"START". START installs the hook, prints EXPERIMENTAL LOAD HOOK ACTIVE, and
shows the program menu. The hook stays installed after the selected program
starts. Source programs are not patched.

This mode reroutes supported standard KERNAL LOAD calls through the resident
D65 reader, including calls made by BASIC BLOAD. Programs using those calls can
read files in extended sectors without calling our custom API. The desktop
importer keeps all source files together; duplicate names still need resolving.

Supported calls
---------------
* ROM 920413, with the original KERNAL LOAD vector. Installation checks a CRC32
  of the complete visible 8 KiB KERNAL and refuses different code. It does not
  flash, alter, or replace the ROM.
* Drive 8, including the ROM's default-device setting when it resolves to 8.
  Other devices pass to the saved original ROM LOAD routine.
* Exact PETSCII PRG names, 1-16 characters; optional 0: prefix. No wildcards,
  directories, '$', or type suffixes. The directory itself remains ROM-readable
  before installing the hook. Use the START menu while the hook is installed.
* LOAD and VERIFY: secondary address 1 (or other nonzero value) uses the file's
  stored address; secondary address 0 uses the requested X/Y destination.
* KERNAL raw LOAD/VERIFY flag $40 with secondary address 0 includes the PRG's
  two-byte header. Normal LOAD/VERIFY omits it.
* SETBNK destinations 0 or 1, with the entire output inside $2000-$F6FF. The
  caller must keep its running code and live data clear of that destination.
  File staging is limited to 57,344 bytes, including any two-byte header.
* VERIFY reports a mismatch through READSS bit 4, as this ROM does, with carry
  clear and no change to the destination. Missing files return KERNAL error 4.
* Exact START loads pass to the ROM, so the same compilation can be restarted.

Limits
------
This is a LOAD hook, not a complete DOS replacement. OPEN, CHKIN, BASIN, CLOSE,
SAVE, command channels, custom track loaders and direct internal ROM calls are
not intercepted. SEQ/USR reads still use the resident API. Programs that depend
on those other calls, C64 mode, bank wrapping, larger reads or different memory
layouts are not automatically compatible. We have not tested arbitrary games.
Do not SAVE, SCRATCH or VALIDATE the read-only compilation.

Reserve bank 0 $1600-$1EFF (2,304 bytes) and physical $87EE000-$87FFFFF (72 KiB
at the top of Attic RAM). This is 8 KiB more than the normal resident service.
The gateway is at $1C40, the 256-byte logical-sector buffer at $1D00, and hook state at
$1E80-$1ED7. The adapter lives at $87EE000-$87EFFFF; staging and catalogue remain
at $87F0000 and $87FE000. It temporarily maps the adapter into $2000-$3FFF and
restores the caller's complete mapping before returning. These reservations
are conventions, not hardware protection. A program can overwrite them.

Calls are synchronous and non-reentrant, with interrupts disabled. Extended
I/O, the utility area and KERNAL must be mapped normally at entry. Standard
KERNAL zero-page/base-page conventions still apply. No interrupts may call the
service concurrently. The public resident API remains available as documented
in Resident-driver.txt. Command 5 is private to the hook and is not an app API.

Before changing the mounted image, starting another compilation/mode, or
restoring an old freezer snapshot, reset the machine. Alternatively, while the
same installation is intact, BANK 0:SYS 7238 removes this LOAD hook; then mount
the next image and run its START. The catalogue describes the installed image;
there is no automatic remount detection. Freezer snapshots can lose Attic RAM.
If code or high memory was overwritten, reset instead of calling uninstall.

Install errors
--------------
LOAD HOOK INSTALL FAILED 129: KERNAL fingerprint does not match ROM 920413.
LOAD HOOK INSTALL FAILED 130: another LOAD hook is already installed.
Neither condition replaces the existing LOAD vector. Do not bypass the checks.
Reinstalling our intact hook is supported. Uninstall restores only our LOAD
vector and refuses to replace somebody else's hook.

First hardware checks
---------------------
HOOKBAS.D65: RUN"START", select 1. Expected BASIC BLOAD SECOND FILE OK.
This is a plain BASIC program using BLOAD"LEVEL",B0,P49152,U8; its LEVEL file
starts at track 1, logical sector 40, beyond normal ROM geometry.

HOOKTEST.D65: RUN"START", select 1. Expected ALL 14 LOAD HOOK CHECKS PASSED.
Its LEVEL file starts at track 1, logical sector 43. It tests ordinary LOAD,
relocation, bank 1, raw loading, VERIFY, error handling, drive 9 fallback,
uninstall/reinstall, and restoration of memory mapping and CPU state. Leave
drive 9 empty for this diagnostic. It writes test bytes only to RAM, not disk.
If it prints LOAD HOOK TEST FAILED, enter BANK 0:PRINT PEEK(7922) and
record that check number.
Reset between images. Both test images contain only original test programs.

Validation
----------
The real Xemu CPU, enhanced DMA, Attic RAM, floppy controller and ROM 920413 pass
14 KERNAL-call checks and the plain BASIC BLOAD example using D81 controls.
Those controls put LEVEL in ordinary sectors and enable the reader's developer
D81 flag. Real D65 images keep that flag off. The installed Xemu does not
correctly mount these D65 images. Extended reads additionally pass the CPU/FDC
harness with modeled DMA and D65 addressing. No physical-hardware success is
claimed for this new hook; test HOOKBAS and HOOKTEST on the MEGA65.
See verification/load-hook/Results.txt for exact evidence and reproduction.
